versions.subject: new rules related to possible dll sideloading
versions.detection:
selection:
    ImageLoaded|endswith: '\rcdll.dll'
filter:
    ImageLoaded|startswith:
        - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\'
        - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Windows Kits\'
condition: selection and not filter
versions.spl: ImageLoaded="*\\rcdll.dll" NOT (ImageLoaded IN ("C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Microsoft Visual Studio\\*", "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Windows Kits\\*"))
